parsed.reason: The reply correctly hands over the referral link (which is appended and present), and correctly tells the parent to forward it themselves. It also adds a brief description of what Hale does, which is helpful context for a referral message. The link is the runtime-appended one, not invented. The reply is a bit long and includes an unsolicited pitch sentence ("Hale is a text-line family assistant - schedule, activities, parenting questions, all over SMS") that Sam didn't ask for and that adds bulk without serving the question, but it doesn't cross into a serious error. No greeting, no sign-off, no markdown. One small blemish for the extra promotional sentence that pads the reply beyond what was needed.
